pandas.Series.rename

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Change labels using a mapping or callable. A Series can also receive a new name.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

  • Returns

Call syntax

Series.rename(index=None, *, axis=None, copy=…, inplace=…, level=None, errors='ignore')
